title: Lüshun Museum Main Building
geometryBasis: Native museum polygon uses the central projection, stepped side walls and rounded rear end. Plate I identifies the north elevation.
sectionBasis: The exact public-domain 1925 plate shows a central pediment and cupola, an open deep entrance, tall Ionic orders, roofline projections and recessed walls. The museum’s present building is the protected historic main building.
limitations: Covered north entrance, projecting bays and central tower follow the 1925 photographic evidence. Rear wall heights, paint tones and small sculptural details are approximate.
The model covers the protected former Kwantung Government Museum and attached ranges. The later separate museum building is outside the placement.
